services.desc: Rent Watch Tower Lodge at Black Hawk State Historic Site for weddings, receptions, business meetings, conferences, dinners, or any other event. The 75 year old lodge was designed by state architect Joseph Booton in 1932 and built entirely from local limestone and timber. The Watch Tower Lodge Rental Fee is $1,400 (plus a $500 damage deposit to be refunded if rules are followed and building is left in good condition) and includes: Meet us at the North end of the park by the fire circle for fall fun! Take a luminated hike along the tree line, enjoy a wildlife puppet show, and sign up for the pumpkin carving contest! Pumpkin Carving Contest 5:30-6:30 Pumpkins provided but bring your own
